Brand-New Amangati to Complete a Spectacular Wellness-Centric Atlantic Passage
10 photos
Photo: Aman At Sea/Instagram
One of the newest and most impressive ships to join the luxury cruise sector is Amangati, the first ship operated by hospitality luxury brand Aman. Amangati’s maiden season, set to debut in 2027, is already available for booking, but one of the most spectacular voyages is announced for the end of 2027 and beginning of 2028.
Aman Group is one of the latest luxury hospitality brand to dive into the world of luxury cruising, expanding their operations from hotels and resorts to sea travel. Aman at Sea, a joint venture between Aman Group and Cruise Saudi, was established in 2023, and it will operate the brand’s first cruise ship, the superb Amangati.
“Aman” means peace in Sanskrit, and “Amangati” translates to “peaceful motion”, a beautiful symbol of the brand’s “peaceful luxury” concept, reflected in every one of the 36 hotels and resorts operated in some of the most breathtaking locations on earth.
Amangati follows the popular industry trend of “superyacht-inspired” cruise ships, either motor yachts or sailing yachts. The idea is to go beyond boutique cruising and offer an onboard experience that’s as close as possible to that of a private superyacht – from enhanced privacy for each guest to pampering comfort and impeccable service.
The 600-foot (183 meters) Amangati will offer no more than 47 suites, for a more intimate onboard experience. Superyacht-inspired amenities include a stunning 16-meter (52.5-foot) swimming pool on Deck 6, spacious suites with full-height windows and spa-like en-suites, plus a generous water toy box coupled with a large beach club, very similar to that of popular charter yachts.
Following the inaugural Mediterranean season planned for mid-2027, Amangati will get ready for a spectacular Winter season comprised of Atlantic Passages centered around wellness. The first 13-night Atlantic Passage from Malaga to Saint John’s will include four port stops. The itinerary is designed to follow the ancient mariners’ route to Cadiz, and the Azore islands, before sailing into the Atlantic.
Prices are steep, with the Deluxe Suites ((703 to 731 square feet) starting at $54,600 per voyage, as the most affordable options onboard. The Grand Suite, spanning more than 1,000 square feet and located forward on Deck 6, costs a whopping $132,600 per voyage.
The Aman Suite, which is the signature suite onboard Amangati, is a spectacular living space of almost 4,000 square feet, complete with its own massage room and a huge terrace with a private jacuzzi. The most expansive accommodation option is the Premier two-bedroom suite that brings together the Aman Suite and an adjoining Premier Suite. Pricing for each of these opulent options is only available upon request.
Toward the end of March 2028, Amangati will depart Saint Jonh’s and embark on its second Atlantic Passage, an 11-night journey ending in Madeira, on March 31 2028.
